list.title: Do I need an expert prescription for Ketoconazole Shampoo?
list.content: No, 1% ketoconazole shampoo is not an Rx product. You do not require a prescription for it and can get the shampoo by placing an order with us.

list.title: How long must I use this Anti Fungal Shampoo for dandruff to see results?
list.content: You will notice visible reduction in dandruff after 2-3 washes. Use this Ketoconazole Anti Dandruff Shampoo for at least 12 weeks to stop dandruff completely. This shampoo has ketoconazole to help you stop the growth of dandruff immediately.

list.title: What are the side effects of this Ketoconazole Shampoo for Dandruff?
list.content: There are no side effects. However, if you face excessive dryness or irritation in your scalp due to the ketoconazole in the shampoo, consult your expert at the earliest.

list.title: What else can I use with this Dandruff Shampoo for women? Will it make my hair too dry?
list.content: Ketoconazole has slight drying properties. You can use Bodywise's Moisturising Conditioner for women to moisturise & nourish your hair along with Bodywise's Hair Strengthening Serum to strengthen your hair follicles & protect your hair.
